label: SYNTHETIC ADVERSARIAL SCENARIO 15: Ownership Summing Above 100%
description: Filing claims that two different holding branches both hold large stakes that mathematically sum to > 100% (e.g. Branch A holds 60%, Branch B holds 60% of the same target). Calculator must cap upper bound at 100% and flag for human review as mathematically inconsistent.

documents.content_text: Conflicting PSC Filing: Branch A Ltd holds 60% of voting shares in Target Corp 15 Ltd. Branch B Ltd holds 60% of voting shares in Target Corp 15 Ltd.
PSC confirmation: George Smiley holds 100% shares in Branch A Ltd.
PSC confirmation: George Smiley holds 100% shares in Branch B Ltd.
